newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products gain $1, except sluggish gasoline.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products gain $1, except sluggish gasoline.

text.p: NWE oil products firmed by an average $1 on Tuesday as futures staged a modest recovery from Monday's lows, but gasoline was unchanged, dealers said.
Eurograde gasoline was offered at around $189 for running refinery Rotterdam material. Earlier, one barge had traded at $188 fob AR and, very early, one sold at $185 fob ARA.
"I think that early deal was a little on the low side," one trader said.
Swaps were barely changed from Monday's close.
Dealers said there was still plenty of stored material available and at least one trader seemed willing to offer it.

Heating oil barges gained by around $1 a tonne as IPE gas oil futures firmed. Offers for prompt remained at IPE June +75 cents/+$1 fob Rotterdam. Traders said buyers were unconvinced the market had bottomed out and most kept out of the market.
High sulphur fuel oil barges gained $1. Barges traded at $86.00 fob Rotterdam and $85.50 for lower grade and stored RMG material in early business. Later each grade had sold at $1 a tonne higher.
Traders said bunker demand again appeared poor, but there was a shortage of refined product, at least until mid-month, and still some shorts needing to be covered.
